current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Partly cloudy. Low around 67, with temperatures rising to around 69 overnight. Southeast wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms between 7am and 1pm, then showers and thunderstorms likely between 1pm and 3pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly sunny. High near 81, with temperatures falling to around 79 in the afternoon. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of rain showers between 7am and 10am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms between 10am and 1pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly sunny, with a high near 81. Southeast wind 5 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms between 7am and 10am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms between 10am and 4pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 80. Southeast wind 5 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms after 7am. Partly sunny, with a high near 82. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms likely before 1pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Cloudy, with a high near 74. Northwest wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Monday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Slight Chance Rain Showers then Mostly Cloudy
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers before 7am. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 68. Northeast wind around 10 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Tuesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly sunny, with a high near 74. Northeast wind around 10 mph.
